name: COBRAS
introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Return to the start position and repeat.

tips.text: Stretch your abdominals as much as you can.
Inhale when you go up, and exhale when you go down.
This is a great exercise to strengthen your back.
